title: A phone call across India
body: Two friends are talking on the phone late in the afternoon. One lives in Porbandar, on the coast of Gujarat in western India. The other lives in Tinsukia, in Assam in the far east of India. The friend in Tinsukia says that the sun has already set and it is getting dark outside. The friend in Porbandar is surprised and replies that it is still full daylight there. Both of them look at their watches, which are set to Indian Standard Time, and the watches show the same time. For this case, take the difference in longitude between Porbandar and Tinsukia to be about 30 degrees. Remember that the Earth spins from west to east, making one full turn of 360 degrees every 24 hours.
